title: DREAM Technical Report
abstract_en: Industrial recommender systems commonly use cascaded retrieval, ranking, and re-ranking pipelines. Although efficient, these pipelines fragment information and objectives across modules, rely on rigid rules, and have limited awareness of real-time intent, leaving session-level shifts among browsing, comparison, and purchase insufficiently addressed. We present DREAM (Developing Recommender Engine with Agentic Methods), an autonomous optimization control architecture that adds a perception-aware, orchestrable, and auditable policy layer atop existing pipelines without replacing them. DREAM has two core components. First, a three-tier Intent Engine fuses on-device signals into structured L0/L1/L2 intent representations; its edge-cloud trigger chain reduces reporting volume to approximately 8.7%. Second, a Meta Engine uses a MetaModel for layered M1-to-M2-to-M3 reasoning: intent summarization, strategy planning informed by Strategy Memory, and parameter translation. It dispatches the resulting parameters through a unified outlet with safety guardrails. A Reward Dual Loop continuously optimizes both components by combining offline simulation for strategy-space exploration with online feedback for outcome calibration, forming a cycle of generation, execution, evaluation, and experience accumulation. Large-scale A/B tests on Taobao's homepage feed show that re-ranking control alone improves IPV by 2.06%, Core IPV by 2.39%, and GMV by 0.88%. Extending control to fine ranking raises these gains to 2.71%, 3.06%, and 1.31%, respectively, while consistently improving PV by more than 1%. These gains require neither replacement of pipeline models nor compromise of serving stability, supporting agentic meta-control as a viable paradigm for industrial recommendation.
abstract_zh: 工业推荐系统通常采用级联式 retrieval、ranking 与 re-ranking 流水线。虽然这种架构高效，但不同模块之间的信息与目标被割裂，系统依赖固定规则，对用户实时意图的感知有限，难以充分应对会话级别在浏览、比较与购买之间的动态变化。本文提出 DREAM（Developing Recommender Engine with Agentic Methods），一种自主优化控制架构：它不替换现有推荐流水线，而是在其上增加一个具备感知、编排与可审计能力的策略层。DREAM 包含两个核心组件：其一是三层 Intent Engine，将端侧信号融合为结构化的 L0/L1/L2 意图表示，并通过边云触发链将上报量降至约 8.7%；其二是 Meta Engine，利用 MetaModel 进行 M1-to-M2-to-M3 分层推理，包括意图总结、结合 Strategy Memory 的策略规划，以及参数翻译，并通过统一出口与安全护栏下发控制参数。系统还引入 Reward Dual Loop，通过离线仿真探索策略空间、在线反馈校准效果，持续优化 Intent Engine 与 Meta Engine，形成生成、执行、评估和经验积累的闭环。淘宝首页信息流的大规模 A/B 测试显示，仅控制 re-ranking 即可带来 IPV +2.06%、Core IPV +2.39%、GMV +0.88%；进一步扩展到 fine ranking 后，收益提升至 IPV +2.71%、Core IPV +3.06%、GMV +1.31%，同时 PV 稳定提升超过 1%。这些收益无需替换原有流水线模型，也不牺牲服务稳定性，表明 agentic meta-control 是工业推荐系统中的可行范式。
key_points_zh: DREAM 将 agentic meta-control 引入工业推荐系统，在不替换 retrieval、ranking、re-ranking 既有模型的前提下，实现对推荐流水线的上层策略控制。
三层 Intent Engine 将端侧用户行为信号转化为 L0/L1/L2 结构化意图表示，并通过 edge-cloud trigger chain 将信号上报量压缩到约 8.7%，兼顾实时性与成本。
Meta Engine 使用 MetaModel 进行 M1-to-M2-to-M3 分层推理：先总结用户意图，再结合 Strategy Memory 制定策略，最后翻译为可执行的推荐参数并经安全护栏下发。
Reward Dual Loop 结合离线仿真与在线反馈，持续优化意图建模和策略生成，形成生成、执行、评估、经验积累的闭环优化机制。
淘宝首页信息流 A/B 测试显示，DREAM 在 re-ranking 与 fine ranking 控制场景下均显著提升 IPV、Core IPV、GMV 与 PV，证明其具备工业级部署价值。

llm_assessment.comment: A highly relevant industrial recommendation paper showing agentic intent-aware meta-control with large-scale Taobao online gains.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇高度相关的工业推荐论文，展示了具备意图感知的智能体元控制并在淘宝大规模线上取得收益。
